skill2: ■ Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part. Affects self if self is not in A.N. Mode status.
Single Point Attack: Sustained damage ▲ 47.32% for 15 sec.

caveats: ⚑ TRIGGER MAPPING: skill1 sustained-damage line keys on 'performing a Full Charge attack'. Encoded as shotFired (an RL trigger pull in this engine is a full-charge shot). If the engine can fire an RL uncharged, or full charges are counted separately, the faithful key is chargeCounter {count:1}. UNVERIFIED.
⚑ CADENCE TUPLE: DoT instance count is driven entirely by the datamine-unreliable RL cadence (chargeFrames 60, reloadFrames 141, ammo 6). Every damage number in this override moves with it.

⚑ STACK CAP: kit caps the sustained damage at 10 stacks; the engine appends one independent DoT instance per fire with NO cap. At the estimated RL cadence only ~3-4 instances overlap inside the 5s window, so the cap is believed non-binding — but it is UNENFORCED, and a faster real cadence would over-credit.
⚑ noFb on the burst nuke: set per the standing prior that burst-cast instant damage lands before the FB window opens. Not measured for this unit.
⚑ crit on the burst nuke: set per the standing rider prior (riders crit at the caster's sheet rate, no core). Not measured.
⚑ DoT crit: left OFF (default). Most DoTs are validated non-crit; opt in only if popup colour on a real recording shows orange sustained ticks.

⚑ 'Start of battle' 5s window encoded as a passive trigger + durationSec 5, i.e. applied at frame 0 and expiring at t=5s. If the engine treats passive as unexpiring, this block would be permanently live — verify by inspection of the buff-expiry path.

PARTLESS BOSS: both Vital Attack blocks (partsDamagePct) are INERT in v1, and the Single Point Attack chain (sustained ▲47.32%) is UNREACHABLE — its trigger is part destruction, which the scope-lock boss cannot produce. Raven loses a large sustained-damage multiplier on this fixture relative to a real parted boss; do not read the resulting board number as her real ceiling.

A.N. Mode is modeled only as its damage effect (the burst self-buff). The mode STATUS itself (which suppresses the skill2 part-destruction branch and removes Single Point Attack) is not represented — harmless while that branch is unreachable, but it must be revisited if parts are ever modeled.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Raven (RL/Iron/Attacker/B3) is a sustained-damage carrier: S1 appends a 5s / 1s-tick 68.46% sustained DoT per full-charge shot (kit cap 10 stacks, engine-uncapped) and grants herself ATK ▲47.52% of her own ATK for 10s on Full Burst entry; her burst is a 492.3% instant nuke plus A.N. Mode's Sustained Damage ▲89.44% for 10s, which multiplies the S1 DoT. S2's Vital Attack part-damage buffs are parsed but inert on a partless boss, and the Single Point Attack branch (Sustained Damage ▲47.32%) is unmodeled because its part-destruction trigger has no schema representation and cannot fire in v1 — see unmodeled + caveats.

flags.estimate: {kind:'shotFired'} — fires once per RL trigger pull
flags.reasoning: The kit says 'when performing a Full Charge attack'. Base stats carry chargeFrames 60, implying the engine charges the RL, and an RL trigger pull should therefore BE a full-charge shot — making shotFired exactly equivalent. The schema's explicit per-full-charge key is chargeCounter, but its documented semantics are phase-CYCLING (effects[P] per phase); with a single effect and count:1 its wrap behaviour at phase 1 is unverified, so shotFired is the lower-risk encoding of the same cadence.
flags.recipe: Read sim.ts's RL shot path: confirm a charge weapon emits exactly one 'shot' event per completed charge and cannot fire uncharged. If it can fire uncharged (or emits a shot at charge START), re-key to chargeCounter {count:1} and re-check instance count. Cross-check against a Raven recording: DoT popup groups should equal rocket count, not exceed it.

flags.estimate: ~1 full-charge shot per ~2s → ~3 overlapping DoT instances in the 5s window; ~6 shots then a 141-frame (~2.35s) reload
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: the cadence is built from datamine-unreliable fields (chargeFrames 60, reloadFrames 141, ammo 6) and no rate_of_fire was supplied at all for this RL. Raven's entire sustained output is instance-count × 68.46%, so a cadence error scales her whole damage linearly — this is the single highest-leverage unknown in the file.
flags.recipe: Frame-count one Raven magazine on footage: charge-start → shot-landed frames for the effective charge time, dry → refilled frames for the effective reload, and shots-per-magazine for ammo. Then count concurrent sustained popups in a 5s window and compare to the sim's DoT instance count.

flags.estimate: Non-binding — expected ~3-4 concurrent instances vs a cap of 10
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #4 (stack/currency steady-state). The engine appends independent DoT instances and never dedups or caps, so the kit's 10-stack ceiling is UNEXPRESSED. It only over-credits if the real full-charge cadence exceeds 2 shots/sec, which the 60-frame charge makes implausible — but that inference rests entirely on the ⚑ cadence above, so the two flags stand or fall together.
flags.recipe: Once the cadence is measured, compute floor(5 / shotInterval) + 1. If it reaches 10, the DoT must be re-encoded as a capped stacking buff or the cadence-derived instance count hand-limited; log the measured value in the note either way.

flags.estimate: true (nuke excluded from the +50% Full Burst major)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #6: per-kit noFb is measured-only and defaults OFF. It is set here solely on the standing prior that burst-cast instant damage resolves before the Full Burst window opens — a convention, not a measurement for this unit. If Raven's nuke actually lands inside her own FB window, this under-credits her burst by a full 1.5×.
flags.recipe: Read the nuke popup's frame vs the Full Burst banner frame on a Raven recording; or run the comp with noFb toggled and compare the burst popup's magnitude against ATK × 4.923 × (1.5 if in-FB) × crit/core state.

flags.estimate: true (rolls at Raven's sheet crit rate, no core)
flags.reasoning: Standing rider prior — flat-damage riders crit at the caster's rate but receive no core bucket unless the text says 'core strike damage', which this line does not. Not measured for Raven specifically.
flags.recipe: Popup-colour check on footage: an orange (crit) burst nuke confirms crit:true; a red 'CORE HIT' would instead mean the line needs core:true, which the prose does not support.

flags.reasoning: Most DoTs in this repo are validated non-crit and the global DOT_CRIT gate is default-OFF; per-DoT crit is opt-in ONLY where measured. Raven's kit gives no signal either way. Leaving it off is the conservative faithful default.
flags.recipe: Colour-read the 1s sustained ticks on a Raven recording (orange + crit icon = critting). If a meaningful fraction crit, set crit:true on the dot and note the observed fraction.

flags.reasoning: No battleStart trigger exists in TriggerDef. A passive is applied at frame 0, which matches 'start of battle', and the 5s window is carried on the buff. Whether the engine actually expires a duration-bearing passive (rather than holding it for the whole fight) is unverified from the schema alone. Since partsDamagePct is inert in v1, a wrong answer here moves zero damage today — but it would matter the moment parts are modeled.
flags.recipe: Inspect the buff-expiry path in sim.ts for durationSec handling on passive-triggered buffs, or emit a buffApply for stat 'partsDamagePct' and read its expiresFrame (expect ~5s worth of frames, not Infinity).

flags.reasoning: Its trigger is 'an ally or self destroys an enemy's part' and the scope-lock boss is partless, so the branch cannot fire regardless of encoding; no part-destruction trigger exists in TriggerDef either. Modeling it under a surrogate trigger would fabricate a Sustained Damage ▲47.32% that the real fixture never grants. Consequence: on a real parted boss Raven gains a large sustained multiplier this model omits — her graded-comp number is a floor, not her ceiling.
flags.recipe: Revisit if/when destructible parts are modeled: it then becomes buff {stat:'sustainedDamagePct', value:47.32, durationSec:15} on a part-destroyed trigger, gated off A.N. Mode, and 'Removes Vital Attack' + burst Effect 1 need a real buff-removal primitive to express the Vital ↔ Single Point ↔ A.N. Mode exchange.
